svg.title: Net thrust accelerates a sled
svg.desc: Four equal thrust forces oppose a smaller friction force. Net horizontal force is positive, while normal force balances weight. A constant-mass short-interval model shows increasing speed. Animated motion has a static alternative for reduced motion and print.

g.text: Rocket sled: net force changes speed
Constant-mass idealization over a short interval: x − x₀ = ½at²; vertical forces balance.
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
